verdict.rationale: The evidence describes protocol-version negotiation between agent and platform profiles, but nowhere documents a formal API versioning scheme or deprecation policy for the UCP/MCP endpoints; in fact shopify-ucp-docs-34 shows the prior `/api/mcp` catalog/cart tools were simply removed in favor of UCP with no stated deprecation timeline or migration guarantees, suggesting an ad-hoc rather than documented deprecation process.
